note: Curated by hand for Cortafuego (see pipeline/README.md, 'brigades.json'). units = [Bomba, Forestal, Aljibe, Escala/rescate]; unitsSource/source/arrivalSource null = supuesto. Eaton fire: stations inside the grid from LA County LMS; engine -> Bomba, brush patrol -> Forestal, water tender -> Aljibe, ladder truck -> Escala/rescate; rescue ambulances and USAR are not counted. LA County 19, LAFD 42 and Glendale 23 lie just west of the grid and are left out. No mutual aid and no road cuts are modelled.
